title: My dreams
content: So I’m in the same place every night when I dream. It’s not familiar, but it is while I’m streaming. some of the main places that stand out to me are: *The mall- it’s huge but has a food court (but it’s buffet style but serves diff foods all the time) and has like 2 stores in it. *the amusement park- i always drive through it? And end up on a huge roller coaster track but it my car. *the lake- huge, beach shore, everything becomes dark and creepy once you get out to the middle. Scary fish live in the lake *School- not a lot happens at the school that I can remember (I do work at a school tho in real life) *Dispensary- there’s 2 weed dispensaries that I go to every day? They are just like pop up shops though *hotel- I stay in the hotel. They are constantly making me change rooms. It’s got about 5 floors but the stairs seem never ending. *the house- the house has 3 floors. It has 3 bedrooms, two of them with bathrooms attached. One bedroom is in the basement. The basement has a living room set up, then lots of storage rooms. There is a laundry room with a secret passage. The other 2 bedrooms are on the top floor. I don’t know the man who sleeps in one of the bedrooms. The main floor is scary and I don’t like being on that floor. The door leads out to a cute little patio with lights, and a pool. The pool is scary for some reason. There is a scary old couple that lives next door. *the roads/highway- I always get lost when I’m driving, I end up taking the wrong turn and end up on a huge highway that has endless lanes of tons of traffic. Please let me know if you have any similar details! I’ve been going to this place for probably about a year now. Every single night. Is this normal?
